documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Neochem Bio Solutions Limited reported a revenue of ₹110.7 crores and an EBITDA of ₹22.6 crores for FY26, representing significant year-on-year growth. The company operates an ISO-certified manufacturing facility in Ahmedabad with an installed capacity of 22,000 MTPA, which achieved a capacity utilization of 52.7% in FY26. Management is focusing on diversifying its product applications across multiple end-user industries, such as Home & Personal Care, to reduce single-segment concentration risk and is expanding its geographical presence internationally. Neochem Bio Solutions Limited reported strong financial performance for FY26, with revenue growing over 32% year-on-year to INR110.7 crores and EBITDA increasing by 53% to INR22.6 crores. Management highlighted improvements in capacity utilization, reaching 53% at their Moraiya facility, and a significant de-leveraging of the balance sheet following their successful IPO.

guidance.claim: Management aims to bring trade receivables down to around 120 days by the end of FY27 or H1 FY27.
guidance.quote: Having said that, we understand that it is again going a little out of line as compared to our previous numbers, and we aim to bring it to around 120 days, maybe by H1 FY27 or latest by the end of FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach around 65% capacity utilization by the end of the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: broadly we anticipate that by the end of the current fiscal year, we should reach around 65% capacity utilization.

guidance.claim: Management targets that 30% to 35% of revenue should come from exports over the next three years.
guidance.quote: broadly we see that in next three years Neochem's target is that we should have 30-35% revenue coming from exports.

guidance.claim: Esters and silicones are targeted to contribute around 55% to 60% of total revenue over the next two years.
guidance.quote: We would like these two categories to contribute around 55% to 60% of our total revenue over the next two years.

guidance.claim: R&D spend is targeted to be around 3% of revenue for the current year.
guidance.quote: So these are the three key parameters on which we are carrying out R&D, but broadly around 3% would be the target number for this year.

demand_outlook.claim: Strong local demand and supportive policies are encouraging Indian firms to increase investments in R&D and production capacity.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong local demand and supportive policy are driving Indian firms to invest more in R&D and production capacity

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian textile chemicals market is transitioning toward premium, sustainable, and higher-value manufacturing.
demand_outlook.quote: India’s textile chemicals market is riding a structural shift toward premium, sustainable, higher-value manufacturing.

demand_outlook.claim: Global chemical markets are increasingly seeing sustainability as a core procurement criterion.
demand_outlook.quote: Across global chemical markets, sustainability is increasingly becoming a core procurement criteria rather than a preference.

demand_outlook.claim: The Home and Personal Care segment is viewed as a strategically important growth area due to favorable industry dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: We view HPC as a strategically important growth area, given its favorable industry dynamics, higher value-added product opportunities, and alignment with long-term consumer trends such as premiumization, hygiene awareness, and sustainable ingredients.

demand_outlook.claim: Customers are currently in a wait-and-watch mode for a couple of weeks due to cooling off of raw material prices.
demand_outlook.quote: April was also fantastic, but now that the prices are cooling off a little bit, we see that customers are in a wait-and-watch mode for a couple of weeks, and broadly, they will start procurement again for their next production cycle.

capex_expansion.claim: The integrated manufacturing facility at Moraiya has an installed capacity of 22,000 metric tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Our integrated manufacturing facility located at Moraiya, Ahmedabad, has an installed capacity of 22,000 metric tons per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: The land parcel at Dholka provides strategic flexibility for future capacity expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, our land parcel at Dholka provides strategic flexibility for the next phase of expansion whenever business requirements warrant additional capacity creation.

capex_expansion.claim: No major planned capex is required over the next one-and-a-half to two years.
capex_expansion.quote: we will not require any major planned capex over the next one-and-a-half to two years.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA margin increased to 20.4% in FY26 from 17.2% in FY25.
The company's PAT margin improved to 10.6% in FY26 from 8.6% in FY25.
The cost of materials consumed by the company rose to ₹73.6 crores in FY26 from ₹55.6 crores in FY25.
EBITDA for FY26 increased by 53% year-on-year to INR22.6 crores, with margins expanding to 20.4%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 53% year-on-year to INR22.6 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 20.4%, an expansion of over 300 plus basis points over the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for FY26 stood at INR12 crores, representing a 62% year-on-year growth with a 10.6% PAT margin.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for FY26 stood at INR12 crores, representing a growth of 62% year-on-year. PAT margin improved by 197 basis points to 10.6%, reflecting both operating leverage and improved profitability across the business.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material costs remained broadly aligned with revenue growth during the year.
margins_costs.quote: Raw material cost remained broadly aligned with the revenue growth, reflecting a relatively stable input cost environment during the year.

margins_costs.claim: Management believes sustainable margins for the product mix are around 35% gross margin, 18-20% EBITDA margin, and 10-12% PAT margin.
margins_costs.quote: we believe these margins are sustainable for this kind of product mix and the industries that we currently cater to, around 35% gross margin, around 18% to 20% EBITDA margin, and around 10% to 12% PAT margin.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's capacity utilization reached 52.7% in FY26 with a production of 11,589 MT.
The capacity utilization was 41.8% in FY25 with a production of 9,200 MT.
Capacity utilization steadily improved from approximately 35% in FY24 to 53% in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Over the last few years, capacity utilization has steadily improved from approximately 35% in FY24 to 53% in FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's non-current borrowings decreased to ₹0.7 crores in FY26 from ₹14.3 crores in FY25.
The company's net cash from operating activities was negative ₹19.1 crores in FY26.
The company's net cash from financing activities was ₹25.7 crores in FY26.
Long-term borrowings were substantially reduced to INR0.7 crores in FY26 from INR14.3 crores in FY25 using IPO proceeds.
capital_allocation.quote: Long-term borrowings were substantially reduced to just INR0.7 crores in FY26 from INR14.3 crores FY25. This reflects our disciplined approach to capital allocation and our decision to utilize a portion of IPO proceeds towards repayment of legacy debt.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-to-equity ratio improved significantly from 1.8 in FY25 to 0.2 in FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Our debt-to-equity ratio has improved significantly from 1.8 in FY25 to 0.2 in FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: Short-term borrowings stood at INR17.1 crores and comprise working capital facilities.
capital_allocation.quote: Short-term borrowings stood at INR17.1 crores and primarily comprise of working capital facilities used to support inventory and receivable funding requirements.

capital_allocation.claim: Long-term borrowings reduced to Rs 0.7 crores in FY26 from Rs 14.3 crores in FY25.

risks_headwinds.claim: Roughly 30% of the raw materials used are directly related to crude, causing immediate price rises following West Asia tensions.
risks_headwinds.quote: around 30% of the raw materials that we use are directly related to crude. So there was an immediate price rise

risks_headwinds.claim: The business exhibits seasonality, with approximately 55% of annual revenue generated in the second half of the year.
risks_headwinds.quote: It is worth noting that our business exhibits a degree of seasonality with approximately 55% of annual revenue typically generated during the second half of the year, and nearly 30% plus during the fourth quarter alone.
